items.name: PartitionResult
items.summary: Helper container for partitioned record batches

items.name: RecordBatchWriter
items.summary: Writes messages to a delta lake table.

methods.name: arrow_schema
methods.summary: Returns the writer's current arrow schema.

methods.name: buffer_len
methods.summary: Approximate encoded (parquet) size written since the last flush, including files already finalized by a size roll or `MergeSchema` rotation. Monotonic within a flush window, so usable as a threshold for calling [`flush`](Self::flush).

methods.name: buffered_record_batch_count
methods.summary: Returns the number of record batches streamed since the last flush.

methods.name: flush
methods.signature: async fn flush(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<Add>, DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Finalize all files written since the last flush and return their [`Add`] actions, resetting internal state to handle another flush window.

methods.name: flush_and_commit
methods.signature: async fn flush_and_commit(&mut self, table: &mut DeltaTable) -> Result<Version, DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Flush buffered files and commit them to the Delta log, creating a new version.

methods.name: for_blind_appends
methods.summary: Creates a [`RecordBatchWriter`] to write data to an [`BlindDeltaTable`].

methods.name: for_table
methods.summary: Creates a [`RecordBatchWriter`] to write data to provided Delta Table

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Resets internal state, discarding any data written since the last flush.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(table_uri: impl AsRef<str>, schema: ArrowSchemaRef, partition_columns: Option<Vec<String>>, storage_options: Option<HashMap<String, String>>) -> Result<Self, DeltaTableError>

methods.name: try_new_checked
methods.signature: async fn try_new_checked(table_uri: impl AsRef<str>, schema: ArrowSchemaRef, partition_columns: Option<Vec<String>>, storage_options: Option<HashMap<String, String>>) -> Result<Self, DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Create a new [`RecordBatchWriter`] for an existing table after validating table metadata.

methods.name: with_commit_properties
methods.summary: Add the [CommitProperties] to the [RecordBatchWriter] to be used when the writer flushes the write into storage.

methods.name: with_target_file_size
methods.summary: Sets a target file size; once an in-progress file reaches it the writer finalizes it and rolls a new one. Without this — or with `0`, meaning no limit — the writer emits a single file per partition per flush.

methods.name: with_writer_properties
methods.summary: Sets the writer properties for the underlying arrow writer.

methods.name: write
methods.signature: async fn write(&mut self, values: RecordBatch) -> Result<(), DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Write a chunk of values into the internal write buffers with the default write mode

methods.name: write_partition
methods.signature: async fn write_partition(&mut self, record_batch: RecordBatch, partition_values: &IndexMap<String, Scalar>, mode: WriteMode) -> Result<ArrowSchemaRef, DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Write a record batch that belongs entirely to the partition identified by `partition_values`, streaming it into the partition's open file.

methods.name: write_with_mode
